section.name: Apache Tomcat 3.x vulnerabilities
section.p: This page lists all security vulnerabilities fixed in released versions of Apache Tomcat 3.x. Each vulnerability is given a security impact rating by the Apache Tomcat security team - please note that this rating may vary from platform to platform. We also list the versions of Apache Tomcat the flaw is known to affect, and where a flaw has not been verified list the version with a question mark.
This page has been created from a review of the Apache Tomcat archives and the CVE list. Please send comments or corrections for these vulnerabilities to the Tomcat Security Team.

section.name: Not fixed in Apache Tomcat 3.x
section.p: Tomcat 3.x can be remotely caused to crash or shutdown by a connection sending the right sequence of bytes to the AJP12 protocol port (TCP 8007 by default). Tomcat 3.x users are advised to ensure that this port is adequately firewalled to ensure it is not accessible to remote attackers. There are no plans to issue a an update to Tomcat 3.x for this issue.
